newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH HUTMEN GETS TWO UNDERWRITERS FOR ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH HUTMEN GETS TWO UNDERWRITERS FOR ISSUE.

text.p: Polish non-ferrous metals firm Hutmen SA signed agreeents with metals-firm Impexmetal SA and a subsidiary of copper concern KGHM Polska Miedz SA to underwrite part of its new share issue, the Parkiet business daily said.
Parkiet said on Saturday that Impexmetal and KGHM Metale SA decided to underwrite 80,000 shares each, out of Hutmen's up to 370,000 new share issue.
It said the provision for the underwriters would be 0.05 percent, which would effectively lower the price of the shares to 29.99 from the IPO price of 30 zlotys, the daily said.
Earlier in June the treasury ministry said that its Hutmen initial share offering was oversubscribed, with investors bidding for 3,840,305 shares against 1,979,224 shares offered.
Hutmen will offer 90,000 employee shares between June 16 and June 25 and 280,000 open shares between June 30 and July 4.
The firm had a net profit of 4.9 million zlotys in 1996 on pre-tax gains of 9.8 million. It plans to incrase its net profit to 7.6 million this year on pre-tax of 13.0 million.
